angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,064,508 km at 59.96 pc = 0.24 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 16.6766 +/- 0.0273 mas (same row, RUWE 1.11): 59.96 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.530 (1.499 to 1.561) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 1,064,508 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.047 (1.007 to 1.087) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5783 +/- 10.3 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6745589980571162752: teff_gspphot 5782.9453 K (16th-84th percentiles 5772.2915-5792.9004), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6745589980571162752: teff_gspphot 5782.9453 K (16th-84th percentiles 5772.2915-5792.9004), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/sika.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.088, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 181720 (pscomppars): spectral type G1 V, from Santos et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...512A..47S/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 181720: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 181720 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.62 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 181720 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.288, from Santos et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...512A..47S/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6745589980571162752, flags_flame 00: age_flame 8.819128 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 7.942175 to 9.698877)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 181720 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.5 km/s, from Santos et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010A%26A...512A..47S/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
